def h8(fr, r0, c0):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='B' and min(rs)==r0 and min(cs)==c0: return n['hash'][:8]
    return '----'
for h in history:
    a=h.frame.ascii.split('\n')
    print(h.action, 'row63tail:', a[63][-6:], 'P0:', h8(h.frame,52,15), 'S0:', h8(h.frame,41,15))
print('--- UP cycle probe at col0 ---')
for i in range(6):
    r=action(['UP'])
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    print(i, 'P0:', h8(current_frame,52,15), 'S0:', h8(current_frame,41,15), 'row63tail:', a[63][-6:], 'res:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('reward','level_completed','done') if k in last_action_result})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
